how_to_apply: Applications are accepted only by email at [email protected]. They must be sent on or before 23 November 2026 (5:00 PM).
Fill in the prescribed application form printed at the end of the advertisement. Write the post name and the Advt. No. with its date, and paste a recent passport size colour photograph.

Write a brief strategic note (2–3 pages) outlining your vision and roadmap for the growth and sustainability of NITJ TBI.
Send all documents in a single email to [email protected] with the subject line: "Application for the Post of CEO, NITJ TBI".
Duly filled application form (prescribed format), with a recent passport size colour photograph

The form ends with an undertaking that the information is true, correct and complete, signed with the date and place. Supporting documents must be attached for every claim made in the form.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: First Class MBA/PGDM/M.Tech/M.Sc./MS (Research) Preferably with a degree in Science and Technology Minimum 3 years' experience in managing incubation centres or running entrepreneurship development related activities Strong communication and networking skills The age limit is preferably not more than 45 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age and does not mention any age relaxation. The application form asks for total work experience and work experience in the startup ecosystem or projects as on the closing date, in years and months. For the full eligibility conditions, candidates can check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay: a maximum consolidated amount of ₹1,50,000/- per month. The actual amount depends on the qualification and experience of the selected candidate. Tax: Income Tax will be deducted at source (TDS) as per applicable rules. Nature of appointment: purely contractual, initially for a period of one year. Extension: extendable annually, based on performance and the requirements of the Incubator. The notice calls the pay "consolidated" and does not list any HRA or other allowance.

content_sections.heading: NITJ TBI Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Job Description
content_sections.text: The CEO will be responsible primarily for achieving the objectives and goals of the NITJ Technology Business Incubator in a sustainable and growth-oriented manner. The CEO will be the prime interface for entrepreneurs and will manage the operations, planning, marketing and development of NITJ TBI. The notice says the position requires a team player with proven leadership qualities, excellent marketing and organisation skills, and a professional attitude. The CEO will be responsible for the overall leadership, growth and management of NITJ TBI. The duties include, but are not limited to: Developing and implementing strategic plans for incubation and entrepreneurship development. Creating incubation plans and implementing them, assisting in writing business plans, keeping track of the incubation process, and helping incubatees prepare proposals for funding. Marketing the Incubator and actively promoting it through various channels. Identifying, attracting, mentoring and supporting startups and innovators. Building partnerships with industry, government agencies, investors, incubators, accelerators and other ecosystem stakeholders. Facilitating access to funding through venture capitalists, angel investors, government schemes and CSR initiatives. Managing incubation programs, startup support services, events, workshops and outreach activities. Strengthening the mentor and expert network of the incubator. Ensuring compliance with guidelines of the Government of India and other funding agencies. Managing financial resources, statutory requirements and administrative functions of the Incubator. Promoting innovation, intellectual property creation and technology commercialization. Coordinating with faculty, students, researchers, alumni and industry partners to foster entrepreneurship. Preparing proposals, reports, utilization certificates and other documents required by funding agencies and stakeholders. Undertaking any other responsibilities assigned by the Board of Directors/Governing Body of NITJ TBI.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NITJ TBI Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted only by email at [email protected] . They must be sent on or before 23 November 2026 (5:00 PM). Duly filled application form (prescribed format), with a recent passport size colour photograph Detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV) Self-attested copies of educational qualifications, experience certificates and other supporting documents Copy of the Aadhar Card, as asked for in the application form Brief strategic note (2–3 pages) on the vision and roadmap for NITJ TBI The form asks for the applicant's name, father's/husband's name, nationality, date of birth, gender, marital status, current position held, total work experience, work experience in the startup ecosystem/projects, Aadhar number, present address with PIN, email ID and contact number. It also has a table of educational qualifications (exam passed, year of passing, board/university, subjects, percentage of marks). A second table records professional experience in reverse chronological order (organisation, designation, from and to dates, monthly salary, and job role and experience gained). The form ends with an undertaking that the information is true, correct and complete, signed with the date and place. Supporting documents must be attached for every claim made in the form.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are shortlisted, and shortlisted candidates are called for an interview/presentation. Preference in shortlisting will be given to applicants with previous experience in handling incubatees, managing and organizing various programs, and drafting proposals and reports. Meeting the minimum eligibility criteria does not guarantee shortlisting. NITJ TBI reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NITJ TBI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy, for the post of Chief Executive Officer (CEO).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NITJ TBI CEO post?
faq.answer: Applications must be emailed on or before 23 November 2026 (5:00 PM).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the NITJ TBI CEO post?
faq.answer: A First Class MBA/PGDM/M.Tech/M.Sc./MS (Research), preferably with a degree in Science and Technology, is needed. Candidates also need at least 3 years' experience in managing incubation centres or running entrepreneurship development related activities.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the NITJ TBI CEO post?
faq.answer: The age limit is preferably not more than 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the NITJ TBI CEO?
faq.answer: The salary is a maximum consolidated amount of ₹1,50,000/- per month, based on the selected candidate's qualification and experience. Income Tax is deducted at source as per applicable rules.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the NITJ TBI CEO post?
faq.answer: Send the filled application form, CV, self-attested certificates and a 2–3 page strategic note in a single email to [email protected] by 23 November 2026 (5:00 PM).

faq.question: Q7. What should be written in the email subject line?
faq.answer: The subject line must be "Application for the Post of CEO, NITJ TBI".

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the NITJ TBI CEO post?
faq.answer: Applications are shortlisted, and shortlisted candidates attend an interview/presentation. Preference goes to applicants with experience in handling incubatees, organizing programs, and drafting proposals and reports.

faq.question: Q9. Is the NITJ TBI CEO post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely contractual, initially for one year, and is extendable annually based on performance and the requirements of the Incubator.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be admissible for attending the interview/presentation.
